    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A radiogroup with radios (aria-checked), or a tablist with tabs (aria-selected, aria-controls) with kind="tabs"
      - listitem: "Roving tabindex: only the active option is in the tab order; disabled options are skipped by the arrow keys"
      - listitem: Labels are read once; counts and badges are part of the name
      - listitem: Visible focus ring on the focused option
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The indicator slides to the picked option in about 200ms; the edge facing the target leads a touch – short and crisp, no bounce
      - listitem: Labels keep one weight and only change color, so neighbours never shift; hover washes fade in and out in 90ms
      - listitem: When a label or count changes, the option and the whole control morph to the new width and the indicator follows; a new count blurs in
      - listitem: Pressing gives the indicator a little (scale 0.97); dragging it across the options selects as you go
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: If it doesn't fit, it scrolls sideways with soft edges on the sides that hide options and keeps the active one in view
      - listitem: "Touch screens: options are at least 40px tall; a tap picks on lift, so swiping to scroll never picks by accident"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
